newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management to merge with Cozzi.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management to merge with Cozzi.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Monday it has signed a binding letter of intent to merge with Cozzi Iron & Metal Inc, forming a scrap metal recycling company with estimated annualized gross revenues of more than $500 million.
The financial terms of the merger between the two Chicago- based companies have yet to be determined, a Metal Management spokesman said.

Cozzi processed more than 1.5 million tons in 1996 through its operations in Illinois, Pennsylvania, Tennessee and Arizona, the company said. Following the merger, Albert Cozzi will serve as Metal Management's president and chief operating officer, the companies said.
Metal Management shares rose 1/4 to 7-7/8 Monday.
